programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2615

programme.title: Lyxfällan

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing

programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Worst I’ve Ever Seen
programme.desc: Two grandparents are shot to death in their family home. Kenda’s investigation kicks into high gear when his prime suspect flees for the Mexican border.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Mr. Violence
programme.desc: 29yr old Chris is shot in cold blood outside a neighborhood bar. Faced with a trio of suspects, Kenda trusts his gut and makes a controversial decision.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Jekyll & Hyde
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda looks for answers in the death of Calvin Blair, a young man stabbed and left for dead on the roadside.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My Worst Fear
programme.desc: Police are shocked to find a 13-year-old boy killed in an explosion, but their grief turns to alarm when they discover a second, unexploded bomb.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Officer Down
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda is faced with his worst nightmare when he learns a friend and fellow officer, Mark Dabling, has been killed in the line of duty.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Julie Dart
programme.desc: Renowned crime journalist Donal MacIntyre meets former Detective Inspector Bob Taylor to discover how he tracked down savage woman hater, abductor and brutal murderer Micheal Sams.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Nigel Bacon
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews Detective Superintendent Kate Meynell to discover just how close Nigel Bacon, a man with many enemies, was to his killer.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews former Senior Investigating Officer Simon Shuttleworth to discover how he ensured that the murderer of Shaun Cummins would be found guilty.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews Detective Chief Inspector Martin Brunning to discover how the capture of killer Joanna Dennehy led to the discovery of a string of victims.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Anchorage
programme.desc: A sinister “love rectangle” culminates in murder when a local fisherman is found murdered in the wilderness of Anchorage. An unexpected confession nine years later reveals the truth.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Extradition to Thailand!
programme.desc: Junior and Jones reap the benefits that come from extraditing a murderer, and Dangle and Rizzo receive a surprise crash course in surgery.

programme.title: South Park: Douche eller bajsmacka?
programme.desc: När PETA förstör South Parks maskot splittrar diskussionen om en ersättning skolan. Stan hotas av P Diddy och förvisas från stan för att han vägrar rösta.

programme.title: Workaholics: Muscle I'd Like to Flex
programme.desc: Blake och Anders värld går i kras när de förlorar Adam till en superrik puma.

programme.title: South Park: Kabelkaos

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor

programme.title: South Park: För mycket information
programme.desc: Efter en pinsam händelse som involverade intima pojkdelar skickas Cartman för att lära sig kontrollera sin vrede, medan Randy får ta hand om efterverkningarna så gott han kan.

programme.title: iCarly: Aj, Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Driva med Lewbert"-sketch går förskräckligt fel och skadar Carlys oförskämde portvakt. Gänget vårdar honom tills dess att Freddies mamma kommer in och tar över. När en romans börjar spira måste de sätta stopp för den.

programme.title: iCarly: Pajen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Spencer tar med Freddie till sin favorit-pajställe, får de veta att ägaren har avlidit. Ännu värre; det verkar som om hans recept har gått förlorade för alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: En normal jul
programme.desc: I ett försök att krydda julfirandet med en ovanlig julgran, råkar Spencer av misstag sätta eld på alla Carlys julklappar. Ursinnigt önskar hon att hon hade en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kyssen
programme.desc: Sam råkar höra när Freddie erkänner för Carly att han aldrig har kysst en tjej , och avslöjar sedan hans hemlighet på webbshowen. Gibby och Carly tränar Spencer inför uttagningen till det lokala proffs-fotbollslaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en bil
programme.desc: Gänget kör en tävling på iCarly; priset är en ny bil tack vare en lokal bilfirma. Efter att Nevel vunnit, upptäcker ungdomarna att bilfirman inte kände till tävlingen eller gratis-bilen som de påstods ha donerat till tävlingen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sluta Fred
programme.desc: Freddie säger under en sändning att han inte är ett fan av internetsensationen Fred, vilket får Fred att meddela att han tänker sluta att lägga ut filmer för alltid. Fansen blir rasande för att Freddie har orsakat slutet för de populära filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Dubbelgångare
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie smiter ut för att se en kampsport-match, skaffar de dubbelgångare för att lura Spencer att de fortfarande är hemma. Under tiden bygger Spencer en gigantisk version av Newtons vagga.

programme.title: iCarly: Rockidolen
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie uppmanar iCarly-fansen att rösta för att David Archuleta ska ta hem segern i "America Sings", tycker de synd om tvåan och hjälper honom göra en musikvideo. Under tiden lär Sam Spencer hur man ljuger som ett proffs.

programme.title: iCarly: Sams Makeover
programme.desc: När Sam erkänner att hon är kär i en kille i skolan, visar Carly hur hon kan locka honom genom att bete sig mer tjejigt. Under tiden blir Spencer övertygad om att en tjej gillar honom på grund av hans smoking, så han börjar ha den på sig hela tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag dejtar en tuffing Del 1
programme.desc: När Carly dejtar en tuffing, försöker hon hålla deras relation hemlig för Spencer. Under tiden betalar Sam Freddie för att göra en hemsida där hon kan lägga ut alla sin favorit-äckel-filmer.

programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing in Time
programme.desc: A woman is reported missing after a fight with her husband. Police suspect a man who reported a fire in his car. Two tiny drops of blood are found in the interior. Finally, a tiny clue inside the suspect's watchband helps solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Missing Pearl
programme.desc: In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith goes missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns. When investigators find a blood trail that leads to the couple's basement, police are sure they'll find the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Man's Best Friend?
programme.desc: In 1989, 4-year-old April Loveless was found dead in the backyard of her Texas home. Her parents told police that she was attacked and killed by wild dogs. Investigators did not agree.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hand Delivered
programme.desc: In 1995, San Diego police are baffled by a pair of hands found in a dumpster. Through further investigation, they determine that the hands are those of missing person Don Hardin.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Officer Down
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda is faced with his worst nightmare when he learns a friend and fellow officer, Mark Dabling, has been killed in the line of duty.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fractured Glass
programme.desc: When affable ladies’ man Michael Tittemore is gunned down in the dead of night, Kenda first sets his sights on the roommates who were present during the murder.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: George Ferribee, a loving son led astray by addiction, is found executed. When Lt. Joe Kenda learns the victim had recently been kidnapped, he assumes the crimes are related.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Haunts Me
programme.desc: A young mother-to-be is shot and left for dead. To catch her assailant, Kenda must elicit a death-bed confession from the victim herself.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Invisible Hand of Death
programme.desc: Two teens stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder just who in her inner circle could kill so cruelly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Beautiful Shade of Death
programme.desc: When police discover the lifeless bodies of Sophia Gerardo, four children and a house cat, they suspect ritualistic mass murder. But Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers a reality far more frightening.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Anchorage
programme.desc: A sinister “love rectangle” culminates in murder when a local fisherman is found murdered in the wilderness of Anchorage. An unexpected confession nine years later reveals the truth.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Key West
programme.desc: On March 23, 2006, a respected horticulturalist is found dead in his Key West residence, and what appears to be an open-and-shut case proves to be anything but.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Lexington
programme.desc: In 1994, beloved University of Kentucky football player Trent Diguiro was gunned down by a sniper’s bullet. For years the case went unsolved, until a former student came forward.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Tampa
programme.desc: When Tampa bartender Sandee Rozzo was killed, police suspected trainer Tracey Humphrey and asked one of Tracey’s clients to wear a wire, and discovered an unlikely accomplice.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Cleveland
programme.desc: In 2005, the unexpected death of suburban Cleveland resident Rose Marie Essa had doctors and police scratching their heads. An initial autopsy failed to shed any light on the mystery.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Ocean City
programme.desc: In 2002, Erika and BJ Sifrit’s vacation ended with them arrested for robbery. When two dismembered bodies were later unearthed, the connection would reveal a chance encounter that led to murder.

programme.title: South Park: Tittarkampen
programme.desc: Pojkarna blir indragna i ett krig om tittarsiffror när programmet 'Super School News' riskerar att läggas ned, och de sänker sig till vilken nivå som helst för att locka till sig tittare.

programme.title: Another Period: Trial of the Century
programme.desc: Hamish ställs inför rätta för mordet på Scoops LaPue. Lillian försöker använda rättegången för att själv få bra PR, och Peepers njuter av en sista dag i frihet innan han försöker erkänna brottet.

programme.title: South Park: Lägg ifrån dig den
programme.desc: Nordkorea ställer in siktet på South Park.

programme.title: RENO 911!: How We Do It in Reno
programme.desc: Dejected after a day of unsuccessful crime fighting, Officer Dangle rear-ends a civilian and discovers 60 pounds of marijuana in the first episode of this iconic comedy series.

programme.title: South Park: Den magiska busken
programme.desc: Cartman och Butters får tag på en drönare och tar en flygtur i kvarteret.

programme.title: South Park: Succuban
programme.desc: Cartman besöker optikern, en man som gör sig lustig över Cartmans viktproblem genom att kalla honom 'Piggy'.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Help From the FBI
programme.desc: While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.

programme.title: South Park: Döda kändisar
programme.desc: Ike plågas av övernaturliga krafter, så Kyle anlitar professionella spökjägare för att rädda sin lillebror.

programme.title: South Park: Damien
programme.desc: Klassens nya kille övertalar Jesus att kämpa för hans far, Satan, i den slutliga kampen om mellan godheten och ondskan. Cartman blir upprörd när han hör att dusten är på samman dag som hans födelsedagskalas.

programme.title: South Park: Sexhjälpen
programme.desc: Nya vetenskapliga tester avslöjar att vissa av pojkarna på South Park Elementary är sexmissbrukare.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly-galan

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillingar
programme.desc: Freddie försöker bevisa att Melanie, Sams tvillingsyster, bara är Sam som har klätt ut sig. Under tiden, när Carly undervisar Spencers fiende Chuck, försöker Spencer bevisa för Carly att Chuck är ond.

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Den psykiska mördaren från "S.O.S." rymmer från fängelset, där Allison hjälpte till att sätta honom, och ger sig på Allison i hennes eget hus.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison har återkommande drömmar om sitt förflutna, vilket orsakar märkliga och chockerande förändringar i hennes nuvarande liv.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Devalos utreder en av sina nära vänners död och får hjälp av Allison, som har haft störande drömmar om en ung kvinna som verkar vara besatt.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Tiden är viktig när en missnöjd arbetare som inte har något att förlora tar Joe och tre andra som gisslan.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison utreder fallet med en kvinnas mördade make. Samtidigt får hennes bror Michael ett jobb som synsk vid en telefonjour, vilket leder till att han besöker en nödställd kund i Arizona.

programme.title: The Catcher Was a Spy
programme.desc: En ovanlig spion utför ett hemligt uppdrag under andra världskriget, där verklighet och bedrägeri konfronteras i en intensiv kamp mot fienden.

programme.title: Jimmy P.
programme.desc: En orolig indianveteran bildar en exceptionell vänskap med en fransk psykoanalytiker när de försöker hitta botemedel mot deras lidande.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Duncans brutalt uttråkade flickvän Annie har aldrig insett Crowes storhet. Ett oväntat snedsteg leder till att Annie och Duncan gör slut, samtidigt som en oslipad version av Tucker Crowes mest kända album kommer ut.

programme.title: Wonder Boys
programme.desc: En engelsk professor försöker handskas med att hans fru lämnar honom, att hans förläggare som har väntat på hans bok i sju år anländer och de olika problem som hans vänner och medarbetare drar in honom i.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: Wild Mouse
programme.desc: Den berömde musikkritikern Georg (Josef Hader) får börja vända på pengarna när hans chefredaktör (Jörg Hartmann) plötsligt avskedar honom från tidningen i Wien som han har skrivit åt i flera decennier.

programme.title: Surviving Christmas with the Relatives
programme.desc: Två systrar med sina familjer samlas för att fira jul i systrarnas nyligen avlidna föräldrars fallfärdiga hus ute på landet – och det slutar i kaos. Gammal syskonrivalitet blossar snart upp och hotar den glada julstämningen i den här tokroliga komedin.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: Två ensamma själar finner kärlek och en förbindelse mitt i storstadens kaos. En hjärtevärmande berättelse om konst, udda existenser och humor.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes utläggning sprids på nätet och hon blir känd över en natt. Sheldon vill fördjupa förhållandet med Mary Jane och Kara åker hem för att hjälpa till att lösa ett familjeproblem.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul tycks ha allt: intelligens, framåtanda, ett vackert hem, sportbil och en lyxig garderob med designerskor. Ändå saknas nåt i hennes amerikanska dröm - en egen familj.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: När Mary Jane åker in på sjukhus efter sin olycka samlas familjen runt henne. Paul Sr tar hand om David och Helen avlastar dem och tar hand om Lisa medan Kara kämpar för Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two
programme.desc: Trots att New Edition blir R&B-sensationer får de betala ett högt pris för sin framgång när interna stridigheter och yttre tryck leder till att de sätter affärerna framför vänskapen.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Louie Louie
programme.desc: När Mary Jane är fast i hemma och inte kan göra nåt så hopar sig problemen då Cece avslöjar sina utpressningsplaner. Samtidigt anställer SNC Marisol, en ny snygg latina-ersättare.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Matthias och Carma har stora framtidsdrömmar, men Matthias förflutna står i vägen. Trots att han bara är 23 år gammal har han en historia av euforiserande droger, hot från gäng och hjärtattacker.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2806
programme.desc: I Nykøbing F möter vi Daniel, som är far till två barn, men som inte betalar underhållsbidrag och har skulder på konsumtionslån och obetalda räkningar. Daniel gör ingenting för att förändra situationen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Karina från Tommerup på Fyn lever som om hon har mycket pengar och köper designerkläder - men i själva verket kämpar hon för att upprätthålla sin fasad för att dölja sina ekonomiska problem.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 3005
programme.desc: I ett tidigare förhållande fick Michael skulder på omkring 800 000 danska kronor, och även om han har försökt få ordning på sin ekonomi försvinner pengarna från hans konto innan månaden är slut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 3001
programme.desc: Patrick bor i Hvidovre. Under de senaste åren har Patrick isolerat sig mer och mer i sin lägenhet eftersom han skäms över sina stora skulder och över att ha förlorat sitt körkort för att han kört för fort.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2906
programme.desc: Birgitte och Daniel bor i Vejle med dottern Ellen. Birgitte lider av depression och hanterar det genom att köpa dyra köksmaskiner och spela Candy Crush, vilket hon har lagt över 20 000 danska kronor på.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Mrs Tishell återvänder till byn. Martin måste reda ut vad det är för fel på Lorna. Al och Morwenna råkar ut för ett onlinedejting-haveri och kärleken blomstrar mellan Bert och Jennifer.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Hypokondrikern Malcom Rayner har problem med andningen och Martin frågar honom om han någonsin har jobbat nära asbest.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 607
programme.desc: Al får ett besök från två militärpoliser som letar efter James barnvakt, Mike Pruddy.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 608
programme.desc: Louisa åker till Spanien, Bert och Jennifer förlovningsfest avslutas med en smäll. Al hyllas som en hjälte för att ha räddat Carolines liv.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Avsnitt 701
programme.desc: Martin återvänder till Portwenn men utan Louisa som har åkt för att bo hos sin mamma i Spanien.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Party
programme.desc: Kris makes an unexpected but crucial discovery about her past when an old friend arrives.

programme.title: Wildfire: Identity
programme.desc: When she gets thrown off a horse and injured, Kris herself realizes that a career as a jockey might come at a high price.

programme.title: Wildfire: Tina Sharp
programme.desc: Kris turns to painkillers to cope with her injury when the possibility of riding in an upcoming race is contingent upon her getting better.

programme.title: Wildfire: Impressions
programme.desc: Kris and Junior are getting more serious as Junior invites Kris to have dinner with the Davis'.

programme.title: Wildfire: Loyalty
programme.desc: Kris is hired to ride Wildfire although she struggles to remain focused because of her relationship with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: Try It Without The Porsche
programme.desc: Kris meets Kerry Connelly, a sports agent who takes interest in Kris after the results of the Sandpiper Race.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: American Siege

programme.title: Breach

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fire Dot Com
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Mistaken For Dead
programme.desc: In 1988, when a patient dies unexpectedly in the office of California neurologist Richard Boggs, police begin what they think will be a routine investigation. Soon they uncover a bizarre story of corpse stealing, fake identity and sexual perversion.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Evidence
programme.desc: One investigator's quick thinking helps him capture a shoe impression made in snow before the evidence melts away. The shoe leads investigators to Peter Benedict and Frank Lanoue, who are convicted of aggravated assault and robbery.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Disappearance
programme.desc: In 1981, 6-year-old Cassie Hansen disappeared from her Minnesota church during an evening service. After receiving a tip that an older man was seen carrying a small person, police found Cassie's body in a dumpster.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Horse Play
programme.desc: In 1980, Michigan resident Shannon Mohr died in what her new husband, David Davis, reported to be a horseback riding accident. After her death, Shannon's family reported that Davis seemed far from grief-stricken.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treads and Threads
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer's Cattle Log
programme.desc: When police in the Great Plains are called about a dead body, a background check on the victim leads them into a bizarre web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks — all fronted by elderly couple Ray and Faye Copeland.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target
programme.desc: Ballistics: A corpse is found with a gunshot wound to the head; the weapon lies next to the victim. It looks like suicide, but could it be murder? It's a question best solved by ballistics experts.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Formed in the 1830s to protect settlers against Indian attack, the Rangers became part of the Texas Highway Patrol in 1935. Their role has continued to evolve to keep up with changing times; today it includes sophisticated forensics labs.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Beautiful Shade of Death
programme.desc: When police discover the lifeless bodies of Sophia Gerardo, four children and a house cat, they suspect ritualistic mass murder. But Lt. Joe Kenda uncovers a reality far more frightening.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Relative
programme.desc: After a father is found shot in front of his home, Kenda uncovers a vengeful motive behind a deadly family feud.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: John 3:16
programme.desc: A man rushes his friend to the hospital with serious gunshot wounds, reporting they were robbed by strangers. When the facts don’t add up, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team go on the hunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Manifesto
programme.desc: A cabin on the slopes of Pikes Peak catches fire, and a young sheriff’s deputy is posted to guard the scene overnight--then he’s found dead in his patrol car the next morning.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My First Case
programme.desc: In his first case with the homicide unit, rookie burglary detective Joe Kenda volunteers to work a bloody multi-victim shooting deemed “unsolvable” by the veterans.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets: Ocean City
programme.desc: In 2002, Erika and BJ Sifrit’s vacation ended with them arrested for robbery. When two dismembered bodies were later unearthed, the connection would reveal a chance encounter that led to murder.

programme.title: Very Scary People: Charles Manson: The Devil’s Work (Part 1)
programme.desc: The Charles Manson story is told via Manson Family members, victims’ families, witnesses, prosecutors, reporters, authors, and Manson in his own words detailing the horror of the vicious attacks.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skin of Her Teeth
programme.desc: In 1994, a human skull retrieved from an Ohio pond reveals a ghastly crime. Markings on the skull indicate that the victim had been stabbed multiple times and that the teeth had been removed with needle-nose pliers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Line of Fire
programme.desc: In 1996, when a fundamentalist group begins robbing banks near Spokane, authorities know immediately that they are dealing with experienced criminals.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Blood
programme.desc: In rural Canada, Dr. John Schneeberger is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting one of his female patients and his step daughter. DNA tests demonstrate that the doctor is innocent, but the patient insists that he sedated and raped her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pure Evil
programme.desc: In the search for the killer of two Texas teenagers, a behavioral profile led to suspect Jason Massey. Hard science proved the profile was correct, and Massey was executed by lethal injection on April 3, 2001.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Root of All Evil
programme.desc: A suspect's former lover comes forward with a fantastic tale of murder, mutilation and cremation. But there's no way to test the story's validity — until a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist conduct tests where the cremation supposedly occurred.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Where the Blood Drops
programme.desc: Susie Mowbray was charged in her husband's death. Her son was so convinced of her innocence that he enrolled in law school, studied all of the evidence and, eventually, discovered the truth of what really happened between his parents.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Punch Line
programme.desc: In 1994, Rhoda Nathan was found murdered in a Cincinnati hotel room. When hotel employee Elwood Jones visited the emergency room with an infected hand, which he said was cut on a dumpster, the doctor recognized the injury as something else.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sibling Rivalry
programme.desc: In 1991, San Francisco pornographer Artie Mitchell was murdered in his home. His brother and business partner, who was found near the scene carrying a rifle, later confesses to shooting Artie.The question is whether the shooting was premeditated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pastoral Care
programme.desc: In 1981, New York correctional officer Donna Payant disappeared and was later found in a landfill. The medical examiner not only identified the cause of death, but also found an important clue.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2709

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2504

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I säsongsfinalen känner Audrina sig utestängd av Laurens nära vänskap med Lo och funderar på att flytta ut. Lauren gör ett innerligt försök att bli sams med Audrina, men det kan vara för sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: När säsong fyra börjar är läget mellan Audrina och Lo spänt. Lauren försöker göra gott intryck på en ny kille, och ett besök från Heidis syster Holly hotar Spencers och Heidis förhållande.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie blir ovän med sin bror och vän när Lauren springer på Spencer på hennes födelsedag. Kelly Cutrone sparkar nån på People's Revolution och Whitney fyller luckan. Laurens förhållande med Doug kanske går lite för fort fram.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren inser att personkemin hon hade med Doug i high school inte längre finns kvar. Whitney är nervös över att åka till New York, men en dejt med en snygg modell gör henne gladare. Trots försoningsgesten vill Spencer helt bryta med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En hejdundrande resa till Las Vegas går snett när Audrina ignorerar Lauren. Brody tar upp Stephanies förflutna, och grabbarna hamnar i finkan. Heidis syster Holly flyttar in, men Spencer vill inget hellre än att sparka ut henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren och Audrina kämpar för att rädda sin vänskap, men det kan redan vara för sent. Spencer har fått nog av Heidis syster Holly och tar saken i egna händer. Och Brody och Doug lämnar häktet med nåt nytt att berätta.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis syster Holly tar kontakt med Lauren, vilket tvingar både Lauren och Heidi att omvärdera vad som hände med deras vänskap. Audrinas och Justins förhållande sätts på prov när hon jobbar på ett stort event för Epic Records.

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: När Lauren åker på semester med familjen går saker och ting snett i Los Angeles. Stephanie dejtar Doug bakom Laurens rygg, och Audrina och Heidi blir vänner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sanningen om Stephanies förhållande med Laurens ex Doug kommer till slut fram när de alla sammanstrålar på Dougs poolparty. Heidis mamma kommer överraskande på besök till LA och hamnar i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får ett brev från Heidi där hon ber om ursäkt och inser att det bara finns en sak som hindrar dem från att bli vänner igen. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille för att göra Justin svartsjuk, men planen slår slint.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina träffar sin gamla flamma Corey igen och bollar plötsligt två killar. Spencer tvingar Heidi att sparka ut sin syster Holly från lägenheten.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bagging a Killer
programme.desc: In 1999, 9-year-old Valiree Jackson vanished on her way to school near Spokane. Her father, Brad Jackson, reported the disappearance and the entire community started searching for her abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Trouble
programme.desc: In 1995, when off-duty Maine State Trooper Vicky Gardner is attacked by Steven Fortin during a routine stop, it triggers a chain of events which jumpstart a stalled murder case in New Jersey.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cats, Flies & Snapshots
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Lori Auker left her Pennsylvania home for work and never arrived, it took space-age technology, cat hairs and insects to pinpoint the woman's abductor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naked Justice
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Treading Not So Lightly
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shopping Spree
programme.desc: When a woman and her daughter didn't return home from shopping, her husband directed police to a nearby mall. The child's body was found, but there was no sign of the wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Forever Hold Your Peace
programme.desc: When Chris Ochoa confessed to the 1988 rape and murder of Nancy DePriest, the case was closed. 8 years later, Achim Marino confessed to the same crime. Can DNA evidence identify the real perpetrator?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Danger
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Alibi
programme.desc: In 1991, a high school girl vanished after attending a party. The prime suspect had two alibi witnesses for the night she disappeared. A solid alibi can often overcome circumstantial evidence, but forensic evidence is another matter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purr-fect Match
programme.desc: When police discovered the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife, authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents. It was the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Master Key
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother and her two young sons are brutally slain, pressure mounts for the CSPD to catch the cold-blooded monster who did it.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Confession

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Shallow Grave
programme.desc: Lt. Joe Kenda and his team investigate the scene of an apparent suicide, only to be forced to flee when they discover the house is booby-trapped.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Run for your Life

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Magic Bullet

programme.desc: Larry Watt, en försvarsadvokat som har orsakat problem i Allisons förflutna, ber Allison att bli konsult åt honom. Allison har ont om pengar och accepterar hans erbjudande.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Devalos försöker återta åklagarmyndighetens kontor. Allisons stöd för Devalos sätts på prov när hon får syner av senator Jed Garrity, Devalos starkaste politiska anhängare, som är inblandad i en konspiration.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Joes mamma gör ett överraskande besök, vilket oroar Allison eftersom hon inte har sett henne sedan hennes psykiska förmågor blev allmänt kända.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Allison försöker hitta kopplingen mellan Ariels förutsägelse om en klasskamrats mors död, drömmar som rör hennes fall med Cynthia och Devalos mordfall.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Medan Allison arbetar med att hitta en försvunnen lokal flicka får hon reda på hemligheter från Cynthia Keeners förflutna.

programme.title: Medium
programme.desc: Ett chockerande och brutalt slut väntar Allison och Cynthia när de fördjupar sig i det tio år gamla fallet med kidnappningen och mordet på Cynthias dotter.

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: Julian är knarksmugglare och lever gott i Bangkoks undre värld, men hans liv blir komplicerat när hans mamma ber honom leta upp och döda den som låg bakom hans brors död.

programme.title: Savage Grace
programme.desc: De rika har många privilegier men överklassens sköna liv kan också förvandlas till moraliskt förfall och extrema handlingar. SAVAGE GRACE är historien om Barbara som gifter sig med den rike Brooks Baekeland. Även om hon är vacker, har långt rött hår…

programme.title: The Last Face
programme.desc: Direktören (Charlize Theron) för en hjälporganisation I Afrika träffar en fältläkare (Javier Bardem), och tillsammans möter de tuffa utmaningar kring medmänsklighet och livet under oroligheter.

programme.title: Occupation: Rainfall
programme.desc: Den mycket efterlängtade uppföljaren till ”Occupation”, en sleeper-hit från 2018. Två år efter den intergalaktiska invasionen och ockupation av jorden slår de överlevande styrkorna tillbaka i ett desperat markkrig.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: Den fantastiske räven

programme.title: Maybe Baby
programme.desc: Sam och Lucy är unga, attraktiva, framgångsrika, lyckligt gifta och väldigt, väldigt kära. De har därför beslutat att det är på tiden att utöka familjen. De har planerat allt in i minsta detalj, men trots förarbetet blir Lucy inte gravid.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked

programme.title: Bride and Prejudice

programme.title: Games People Play: The Drink of Kings

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mixed Messages

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Exposed

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Hindsight is 20/40
programme.desc: En bild gör att Mary Jane och Andre blir osams. Patrick berättar att han ska flytta ut, Niecy meddelar sina planer efter förlossningen och Kara är upptagen av en vårdnadstvist som innefattar hennes söner.

programme.title: Boomerang: The Let Out

programme.title: Boomerang: Homecoming

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2504

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2904

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 2802

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Resor, dyr elektronik och impulsiva idéer är inte det enda som Andreas döljer för sin flickvän. För när Andreas ser något han vill ha tar han ett lån för att kunna köpa det.

programme.title: Wildfire: Who Are You?

programme.title: Wildfire: For Love Or Money?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby

programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: A Kind of Magic

programme.title: Like Crazy

programme.title: Scorpion SV: Don't Burst My Bubble

programme.desc: För att stoppa ett farligt virus från att spridas måste Team Scorpion hitta en sällsynt utrotningshotad apa i Amazonas som har antikroppen för botemedlet.

programme.desc: While Don is unreachable at a therapy session, the FBI and Charlie try to find the son of a music mogul whose kidnapper threatens to kill the boy if he is not paid a multi-million dollar ransom in one hour.

programme.desc: Charlie tries to connect a series of murders to a voter fraud conspiracy and must track down who benefits the most from the rigged elections before more people die.

programme.title: Numb3rs

programme.title: Numb3rs

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In 1998, police in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin were called to the home of Mark and Julie Jensen. Mark said he had found his wife dead in her bed. But a letter written by Julie before her death expressed her suspicion that Mark might kill her.

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 701

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 702
programme.desc: Bianca och Morten bor i Randers med tung trafik utanför hemmet, och två små flickor som har lärt sig att öppna ytterdörren. Det fungerar inte, så de ber experterna om hjälp.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 703
programme.desc: I Esbjerg har Line och Kristian byggt sitt drömhus, eller det är vad de trodde. Öppna ytor och stora fönster faller dem inte längre i smaken, men vad ska de istället ha?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 704
programme.desc: För några år sedan sålde Birgitte sitt hus, och ångrade det bittert. Nu hyr hon och dottern Emma ett dyrt nybygge medan de letar efter ett hus som liknar det gamla. Kan experterna hjälpa dem?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn

programme.desc: In 1996, Indiana police identified Richard Alexander as the “River Park Rapist” who assaulted four women that year. Later, DNA analysis casts doubt on his conviction.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Death Grip
programme.desc: Fingerprinting: The Identification Division of the FBI relies on fingerprints as one of the most effective ways to identify criminals.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Material Witness
programme.desc: Lies and deceit can often throw investigators off the trail of justice. But when hard evidence contradicts a killer's story, police must use the clues to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A hard-working father of two is shot in the head just steps from a notorious strip club. The case is stuck in neutral until Kenda uncovers a conspiracy organized by an unlikely triggerman.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: After School Special
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when a beloved teacher is poisoned in her classroom. As doctors fight to save Barbara Lewis’ life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: Kenda finds the body of a bruised and battered young woman named Vicki Ross strangled. Kenda must sort through the endless suspicious characters in Vicki's past to find the elusive truth.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Outlaw
programme.desc: When a gunfight erupts at a local biker bar and claims the lives of two men, Lt. Joe Kenda must delve deep into the world of an infamous biker gang.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Avert Your Eyes
programme.desc: When Pamela Edwards is found shot through the heart, Lt. Joe Kenda’s first task is to shield her young daughters from the horrendous scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews former Detective Chief Inspector Clive Driscoll to discover how he investigated the suspected murder of Surjit Athwal, without a body or witness.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Tyska befäl upptäcker effektiviteten i att gasa fångar, och Auschwitz förvandlas från ett litet bakvattenläger för de som motarbetar den nazistiska ockupationen av Polen, till ett storskaligt förintelseläger för judar.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: Höss hanterar komplikationer som uppstår från det provisoriska gaskammaren och den ökande efterfrågan då nazisterna börjar genomsöka hela Europa för fler människor att ta till Auschwitz och döda.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.
